series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN

description.ja: • 『THE ORIGIN』外伝漫画「ククルス・ドアンの島」に登場する局地型ガンダム（北米戦仕様）の改良型MSが豊富な新規武装でキット化！
description.en: • The improved MS of the local Gundam (North American war spec) that appears in the side story comic "The Island of Cucurrus Doan " from " THE ORIGIN" has been made into a kit with a wealth of new weapons!

description.ja: • FSDとは「Full Scale Development」の略語で「先行量産」を意味し、特徴的な腕部ガトリング、特殊な形状の胸部や印象的なシールドは新規で再現されている！
description.en: • FSD is an abbreviation of "Full Scale Development " and means " advance mass production", and the characteristic arm gatling, special shaped chest and impressive seal have been newly reproduced!

accessories.ja: シールド×2（※1点は新規造形パーツ）
accessories.en: Seal × 2 (*1 piece is a new molded part)
